caption: A dog walks between a campfire and a tent at night, and a huge shadow of the dog sweeps across the tent wall.

sa.check: A campfire burns at night beside a tent.
A dog walks between the fire and the tent.
A huge shadow of the dog sweeps across the tent wall.
The shadow is larger than the dog.
The shadow flickers with the flames.

pc.expect: The shadow is on the tent side away from the fire and moves as the dog moves.
pc.fail: It is on the fire side; or it stays still while the dog walks; or it is missing with the fire lit.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the dog's outline, larger than the dog and flickering with the flames.
pc.fail: It is a different animal's shape; or smaller than the dog; or rigid and unflickering while the flames plainly move.

pc.expect: The shadow moves the opposite way to the dog across the tent wall as the dog approaches the fire.
pc.fail: It moves the same way; or stays put; or jumps.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move except with the dog and the flames.
pc.fail: It sweeps with the dog still and the flames steady; or it moves before the dog.

pc.expect: One dog, one fire and one shadow.
pc.fail: A second dog or shadow appears; or the dog vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the dog passes through the tent.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the tent stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the tent changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
